claims.text: The new training algorithm, Morfessor EM+Prune, finds better solutions to the optimization problem defined by the Morfessor Baseline model compared to the original recursive training algorithm.
The improved optimization from the new training algorithm leads to higher morphological segmentation accuracy when compared to a linguistic gold standard.
The study compares the new Morfessor variant with existing methods, demonstrating its advantages in segmentation quality for multiple languages.
